encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D( CASE WHEN ST_SRID(${col}) = 0 THEN ST_SetSRID(${col}, 4326) ELSE ST_Transform(${col}, 4326) END), 3))), 'hex')
mapper.select: SELECT 'school' AS category, objectid::text AS source_id, nullif(trim(adek_sch_name_en), '') AS name_en, nullif(trim(adek_sch_name_ar), '') AS name_ar, nullif(trim(adek_sch_education_type_en), '') AS subtype, nullif(trim(adek_sch_curriculum_en), '') AS sub_category, adek_sch_capacity::int AS capacity, adek_n_students::int AS students, adek_n_total_staff::int AS staff, CASE WHEN adek_sch_education_type_en ILIKE 'Public%' THEN true WHEN adek_sch_education_type_en ILIKE 'Private%' THEN false END AS is_public, nullif(trim(udm_gisid), '') AS gisid, json_strip_nulls(json_build_object( 'esisId', adek_sch_esis_id, 'gender', adek_sch_gender_en, 'grades', adek_sch_grades_en, 'cycle', adek_sch_cycle_en, 'curriculum', adek_sch_curriculum_en, 'rating', adek_sch_latest_irtqaa_result, 'tuitionCategory', adek_sch_tuition_fee_category, 'averageTuition', adek_sch_average_tuition_fee, 'teachingStaff', adek_n_teaching_staff, 'boys', adek_n_students_boys, 'girls', adek_n_students_girls, 'academicYear', adek_sch_academic_year, 'snapshot', adek_report_snapshot::date))::text AS attrs_json, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.schools} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN facility_category = 'Pharma' THEN 'pharmacy' ELSE 'medical' END AS category, objectid::text AS source_id, nullif(trim(facility_name_in_english), '') AS name_en, nullif(trim(facility_name_in_arabic), '') AS name_ar, nullif(trim(facility_type), '') AS subtype, nullif(trim(facility_sub_type), '') AS sub_category, CASE WHEN bed_capacity::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN bed_capacity::text::int END AS capacity, CASE WHEN is_public::text ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['y%', 't%', '1']) THEN true WHEN is_public::text ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['n%', 'f%', '0']) THEN false END AS is_public, nullif(trim(coalesce(permanent_status::text, preliminary_status::text)), '') AS status, json_strip_nulls(json_build_object( 'license', facility_license_number, 'specialities', specialities_subspecialities, 'emergencyLevel', emergency_level, 'region', region, 'city', city, 'plotNumber', plot_number, 'address', address_name_in_english, 'issueDate', issue_date, 'expiryDate', date_expiration))::text AS attrs_json, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.doh} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL AND facility_category IN ('Medical', 'طبي', 'Pharma') AND coalesce(facility_name_in_english, '') NOT ILIKE '%test%'

SELECT 'mosque' AS category, objectid::text AS source_id, NULL AS name_en, coalesce(nullif(trim("اسم_المسجد"), ''), 'مسجد ' || coalesce("رقم_المسجد"::text, objectid::text)) AS name_ar, nullif(trim("صفة_المسجد_1"), '') AS subtype, CASE WHEN "إجمالي_عدد_المصلين"::text ~ '^[0-9]+(\.0+)?$' THEN trunc("إجمالي_عدد_المصلين"::text::numeric)::int END AS capacity, CASE WHEN "عدد_الطوابق"::text ~ '^[0-9]+(\.0+)?$' THEN trunc("عدد_الطوابق"::text::numeric)::int END AS floors, nullif(trim("حالة_المبنى"::text), '') AS status, json_strip_nulls(json_build_object( 'mosqueNo', "رقم_المسجد", 'branch', "فرع", 'area', "المنطقة", 'plotNo', "رقم_القطعة", 'sermonLanguage', "الخطبة_باللغة", 'stage', liv_stage))::text AS attrs_json, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.mosques} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'park' AS category, 'udm-' || objectid AS source_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(nameenglish), ''), nullif(trim(namepopularenglish), '')) AS name_en, coalesce(nullif(trim(namearabic), ''), nullif(trim(namepopulararabic), '')) AS name_ar, 'udm' AS subtype, coalesce(parkid::text, 'o' || objectid) AS park_id, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.parks} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'park_detail' AS category, 'dmt-' || objectid AS source_id, nullif(trim(name), '') AS name_en, nullif(trim(alt_nm_1), '') AS name_ar, 'dmt' AS subtype, json_strip_nulls(json_build_object( 'neighbourhood', neighbh, 'city', city, 'street', st_name, 'hours', x_working_hours_eng, 'entryFee', x_entry_fee, 'playArea', x_multipurposeplayarea, 'mosque', x_mosque, 'kiosk', x_kiosk, 'restroom', x_restroom, 'bbq', x_barbaquearea, 'theatre', x_theatre, 'restaurants', x_restaurants, 'library', x_library, 'games', x_playgames, 'fountains', x_fountains, 'fenced', x_fenced))::text AS attrs_json, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.parkDetails} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL
